description: Every key the web client can put in an image generation request. The gateway whitelists them in server/app/billing.py (server/tests/test_quote.py asserts the whitelist covers this file); any other key is rejected with 400 invalid_parameters. Update this file together with the Dart builder.

parameter_keys.characterPrompts: parameters map, when characters is non-empty
parameter_keys.v4_prompt: parameters map, always present (caption.base_caption, caption.char_captions, use_coords, use_order)
parameter_keys.image: parameters map, action != generate and sourceImageBase64 given
parameter_keys.mask: parameters map, action != generate and maskBase64 given
parameter_keys.strength: parameters map, action != generate and img2imgStrength given
parameter_keys.noise: parameters map, action == img2img and img2imgNoise given
parameter_keys.mask_blur: parameters map, action == infill and maskBlur given
